pairwise_checks.mechanism_difference_statement: F1 uses only per-symbol trailing price returns; carry ranks purely on trailing settled funding with no price-formation term.
Fundcrowd is single-symbol reclaim-MR bar-pattern entries gated by funding-percentile skip rule on 15m bars; F1 is continuous own-return positioning with no funding observable and no pattern trigger.
VOLCOMP is squeeze->Donchian breakout entry pattern with volume-burst confirmation, single-symbol long-only; F1 has no volatility/volume conditioning and no discrete entry pattern.

pairwise_checks.shared_information_source: trailing price returns (one of two V7 terms)
pairwise_checks.mechanism_difference_statement: V7 is a two-term percentile spread (price-return percentile MINUS funding percentile) whose long side can buy relative strength; F1 is a single-term own-return sign rule with no funding term and no percentile spread.

pairwise_checks.shared_information_source: short-horizon alt returns (raw for WREV; BTC-residualized for F2)
pairwise_checks.mechanism_difference_statement: Both are short-horizon loser-winner reversion among alts; F2 trades the idiosyncratic BTC-residualized component rather than raw-return ranks. Because BTC dominates common alt variance, residuals can approximate affine transforms of raw short-horizon returns - exactly the region where WREV was falsified (all lookbacks negative PnL).
required_safeguards: pre-launch orthogonality gate frozen before any scored run: rank correlation between residual-reversal and raw-reversal position sets below frozen threshold on pre-freeze data, else AUTO_ARCHIVE
horizon justified independently of the dead WREV 3D/7D/14D chain
explicit economic-mechanism statement (idiosyncratic inventory/liquidity-provider reversion) that raw reversal does not capture
gate failure => classify as rescue attempt of weekly_reversal_V8 and archive without consuming budget

pairwise_checks.mechanism_difference_statement: Carry orders on trailing settled funding alone; F2 orders on residualized price reversion. No shared ordering variable.
required_safeguards: keep zero funding terms in spec

pairwise_checks.mechanism_difference_statement: Fundcrowd gates individual single-symbol reclaim-MR entries by point-in-time funding percentile; F2 builds market-neutral residual-RV positions from cross-symbol residuals with no funding gate and no bar-pattern entry.

pairwise_checks.mechanism_difference_statement: VOLCOMP trades upside breakout continuations after price-range compression; F2 trades reversion of idiosyncratic moves - opposite post-move hypothesis, different signal variable.

pairwise_checks.shared_information_source: alt price returns (V7 additionally uses funding)
pairwise_checks.mechanism_difference_statement: V7 score is a two-term percentile spread mixing price momentum against funding (can long strength); F2 is pure residual mean reversion with no funding term and no percentile spread.

pairwise_checks.shared_information_source: none (volume vs raw-return ranks); direction opposite to reversal
pairwise_checks.mechanism_difference_statement: WREV bets on cross-sectional reversal of raw-return ranks with no volume observable; F3 selects names by volume-shock outliers and bets continuation. Different selection variable, opposite post-move hypothesis.
Carry is funding-only ordering; F3 is volume-event-conditioned continuation. Disjoint observables.

Fundcrowd's gate is a funding-percentile skip-rule on reclaim entries; F3's gate is a volume-statistic outlier. Different conditioning observable and different trade hypothesis (continuation vs reclaim-MR).

VOLCOMP triggers on price-range squeeze -> Donchian breakout with volume-burst confirmation, single-symbol long-only; F3 must select names via frozen pure volume-outlier statistic and trade short-horizon continuation (two-sided allowed), with NO squeeze/Donchian/price-range precondition. If implementation collapses to breakout-on-volume it IS the rejected family.
required_safeguards: shock defined solely by frozen volume z-score/outlier rule; forbid Donchian/squeeze/price-range preconditions in spec bytes
two-sided continuation permitted (unlike long-only breakout) to keep hypothesis distinct
scoring-time position-overlap report vs archived VOLCOMP grid entries; collapse => family ruled duplicate

pairwise_checks.mechanism_difference_statement: V7 mixes price-return and funding percentiles on a daily clock; F3 conditions on volume shocks only. Disjoint signal variables.
